description.value: The Chilliwack Curling Club has been a community fixture since 1952, growing from a three-sheet facility built with help from CFB Chilliwack into a full community centre with eight sheets of seasonal curling ice. Beyond curling, the building hosts events and gatherings in its banquet halls and meeting rooms, and the on-site 9th End Café serves dine-in meals. The facility also features a fully stocked pro shop, dart boards, and a licensed bar and lounge.

judgement.verdict_reason: Sport club with booking-based access — not walk-in.

Café or food on site.detail: 9th End Café offers dine-in, buffet service for events, banquet menus, plated meals, platters, and take-and-bake options

wow_evidence: Eight-sheet curling club with banquet halls — booking-based sport club per curling ladder.
blurb: Eight-sheet curling club with café, running since 1952.
